notes:
Reliability: unattended and scheduled backups no longer stop when you leave the app - the backup now runs fully outside the app's process group.

Restore: app permissions restore correctly on custom ROMs - per-UID permission modes and a restored app's network-access policy are reapplied (Android 16 and 17). You can opt in, per app, to also back up its network policy.

Settings: exporting settings, or any encrypted backup, now reports a clear message when encryption cannot run on this device, instead of a generic error.

Interface: dragging the interface-scale slider no longer switches tabs.

Languages: Ukrainian added - 22 languages.
